opportunities.title: 1,449 Patches, Still Pwned: Inside the Oracle Flaw That Made Full Compliance Worthless
opportunities.why_now: A fresh Register report shows an org that applied every single Oracle patch got hit anyway, exposing the gap between 'patched' and 'secure.'
opportunities.angle: Breach-digest deep dive on patch-cadence theater — pair with CISA's 3-day emergency directive on the same perfect-10 Oracle flaw to show the before/after urgency curve.

opportunities.title: CISA's Fastest-Ever Patch Clock: 3 Days to Fix a Perfect-10 Oracle Bug
opportunities.why_now: CISA just issued its tightest patching deadline on record for a critical Oracle flaw, days after news broke that full patching still wasn't enough.
opportunities.angle: Ticking-clock explainer with a timeline graphic: CVE disclosure → exploitation → CISA directive → patch deadline, framed as 'the inevitable breach' countdown.

opportunities.title: Boston Scientific's 'Global Disruption': When a Cyberattack Hits Medical Device Supply Chains
opportunities.why_now: An ongoing, still-unfolding cyberattack at a major medical device maker is causing worldwide operational disruption, a rare live-breach situation worth tracking in real time.
opportunities.angle: Live-breach tracker post updated as details emerge — tie to broader 2026 trend of critical-infrastructure-adjacent manufacturers getting hit.

opportunities.title: ShinyHunters Said 26M Carhartt Records, Reality Was 12.9M — The Breach Math Doesn't Add Up
opportunities.why_now: Carhartt's confirmed breach total is half of what the extortion group claimed, a clean data point for the recurring 'threat actors lie about scale' story.
opportunities.angle: Breach-claim vs. reality comparison chart, with a running tally of how often ShinyHunters/other groups inflate victim counts.

opportunities.title: 100+ Water Utilities Hacked in One Month: July's Quiet Critical-Infrastructure Crisis
opportunities.why_now: New reporting reveals over 100 water systems were compromised in July alone, a scale that's easy to miss amid bigger-name breaches but signals systemic exposure.
opportunities.angle: Data-driven roundup mapping attack count against known ICS/OT vulnerabilities and patch cadence for water utilities — the 'nobody's watching this' angle.
